findings.summary: The 2+-step digest input took arguments from the lossy JSON-mode dump: set order varied per process, and Decimal/str, int/str keys and NaN/inf/None collided. Fixed: Python arguments with only placeholders encoded; canonicalize refuses what the 1-step path refuses.
validate_plan passed arguments outside the digest profile. Fixed: KERNEL-ARGS per step; docstring names the caller's per-step domain validation.
KERNEL-PLAN-READ-STEP was not in the design. Fixed: recorded in target 6.4.3 and ADR 0025 Validation.
StepDigestContext.evidence contract undocumented. Fixed: docstring; end-to-end equality is 2c.6's test_on_single_step_approval_presentation_unchanged.
